description: This file contains integration tests for the Loan Product module in the Fineract project. It includes nested classes for testing income capitalization, buy-down fees, and write-off reason to expense mappings, along with multiple test cases for creating, updating, and validating loan product configurations.

classes.name: LoanProductTest
classes.description: Main test class for loan product functionality, extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest. Contains nested classes for specific feature testing.

classes.name: IncomeCapitalizationTest
classes.description: Nested class that contains test cases related to income capitalization features in loan products.

classes.name: BuyDownFeeTest
classes.description: Nested class that contains test cases for buy-down fee features in loan products.

classes.name: WriteOffReasonsToExpenseMappings
classes.description: Nested class handling test cases for mapping write-off reasons to expense accounts in loan products.

methods.name: createTestWriteOffReason
methods.description: Helper method creating a test write-off reason, used in write-off mapping tests.
